name: Scheme of Cash Incentive to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches
benefit:
> For all international events except the Olympics, Paralympics, Asian Games, Para-Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games, cash incentives will be paid based on the number of participating countries.

Amount of IncentiveIn a team event In an individual eventFullThe number of participating countries shall be at least 12 or the maximum permissible number of participants, whichever is lower.
_eligibility_text: The cash incentive shall be awarded exclusively for the sports disciplines specified.
